scope: All 520 decoded textures in packs 02:00035 and 02:00036. Undecoded/skipped children are outside coverage.
coordinate_system: Decoded texture pixel coordinates, top-left origin. xywh boxes enclose nontransparent pixels; label boxes include outlines. These are not runtime screen coordinates.

evidence: Six Japanese location labels, including island overview and pirate ship.
Seven English activity markers: EVENT, SYSTEM, SHOP, FREE, BATTLE, MINI GAME, LESSON.
Standing character tokens, destination-like markers, themed frames, and creature animations.
uncertainties: Exact runtime screens and resource sharing are unverified.
The provisional directory name battle_assets does not establish a battle-only UI.
Creature animations may be reused by multiple screens; a dedicated mini-game assignment is unproven.

limitations: Native graphics were inspected, not edited or translated.
No runtime screenshot, display position, clipping, or layout verification is claimed.
No OCR coverage claim for undecoded resource children. Character identities were not researched.
